leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Construct a Node.js server with Express to handle HTTP requests
Implement a job queue using an in-memory array for storing delayed tasks
Configure route handlers to accept job creation requests with delay parameters
Initialize a background worker process to check and execute pending jobs
Manipulate job statuses (pending, processing, completed) throughout their lifecycle
Integrate job cancellation functionality with proper error handling
Apply setTimeout for delayed execution based on user-specified intervals
